title: Capsule Types Under Capsule Typology
description: Fix sketchpad bug: capsule types do not appear under capsule typology.
summary: Puzzle 2d play window engagement options and brush distribution sliders showed UUID tails because labels used kindId.split('.').pop(). Play shell now resolves labels via puzzle2dNodeKindOverlayLabel / puzzle2dHandleKindOverlayLabel from stored kind catalogs. Playground notifyBrushCandidates uses the same overlay labels for brush window possibles.
